let s_fg := ∑ i, f i * g i
have h1 : ∀ i j, f i * g j + f j * g i ≤ f i * g i + f j * g j :=
  by intro i j; rw [add_comm]; apply (hfg i j)
have h2 : ∀ i j, f i * g j + f j * g i ≤ f i * g i + f j * g j :=
  by intro i j; exact h1 i j
have h3 : (∑ i, ∑ j, f i * g j) + (∑ i, ∑ j, f j * g i) ≤
  (∑ i, ∑ j, f i * g i) + (∑ i, ∑ j, f j * g j) :=
  by { rw [sum_swap, sum_swap], apply sum_le_sum; intro i j; exact h2 i j }
have h4 : (∑ i, ∑ j, f i * g j) = (∑ i, ∑ j, f j * g i) :=
  by { rw [sum_swap], congr'; apply sum_cong; intro j; rw [sum_swap]; congr'; intro i; refl }
have h5 : ∑ i, ∑ j, f i * g j = n * s_fg :=
  by { rw [h4], congr'; apply sum_cong; intro i; rw [sum_swap]; congr'; intro j; refl }
